choices: A real local Git (Linux, macOS, or WSL)

items.explain: Either track is OK for self-study; both is recommended. Later courses expect real-Git comfort with remotes and PRs.

items.prompt: A good first rhythm for a lab module is…
choices: Skip the README and only watch video
Browser lab for the idea, then real Git for practice
Only copy commands without a checklist
items.explain: Browser first for intuition, then real Git for fidelity, is the recommended path.
